source_snapshot.procedure: Reflash the BIOS to the same version, reboot, then verify the version in BIOS setup and OS.
source_snapshot.criteria: The flash completes without errors and the correct version appears in BIOS and OS.
source_snapshot.script: Private check_fw_version_by_ipmitool_raw reference is a readback aid, not a reflash implementation. Twenty minutes attended and twenty machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO because the state-changing pre-OS write is not directly runnable; its log output incorrectly imports the duplicate F3 Optimized Defaults action.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with vendor proof that same-version reflash is supported and necessary, exact image/tool/command, approval, stable power and recovery.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes the write boundary but omits same-version-specific necessity/support and finite execution gates.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly distinguishes same-version support from an upgrade and requires full write/recovery evidence.
historical_reviews.history: Sequence 536 is the distinct F3 Optimized Defaults variant.
historical_reviews.v3_1: An unchanged version string cannot prove the intended image was rewritten; flash telemetry, image identity and configuration comparison are required.

original_test_intent: Prove that the identified platform safely accepts one vendor-supported reflash of the exact currently installed BIOS version and returns with the same correct version and healthy configuration.
original_method: Bind host/board, current version and exact same-version signed image; prove vendor support and purpose, preserve configuration/logs, approve one write/reboot with stable power and recovery, monitor completion, then verify BIOS Setup, OS/BMC and configuration/health evidence.
manual_activity: Owner approves why and how the identical-version write is supported; operator supervises the pre-OS console, uninterrupted flash, reboot and BIOS Setup verification. F3 Optimized Defaults is excluded.
required_inputs: Exact host/board identity and current version
Same-version signed image/hash and vendor support
safety_requirements: Verify identical image/target immediately before write
Stop on unsupported behavior or telemetry loss
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Collect BIOS Setup and OS/BMC evidence
engineer_actions: Justify and approve the same-version reflash
Provide stable power and independent recovery
Resolve configuration differences and own verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek identifies the operation but provides no vendor command and incorrectly imports F3 from duplicate row 359. The private version-read script cannot prove that a write occurred.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After exact vendor support, image, target, command, purpose and recovery are approved, perform one uninterrupted same-version reflash and required reboot, then correlate flash telemetry with BIOS Setup and OS/BMC version plus configuration evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Same-version target, reboot, BIOS/OS checks and 20/20-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use signed-image identity, flash completion telemetry and pre/post configuration/health evidence because version equality alone is not proof of a successful reflash.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds necessity/support, proof-of-write and configuration/recovery controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Distinguishes a real same-version rewrite from a no-op readback.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The write can brick the host despite producing no version change.

project_override_considerations: Project must document why same-version reflash is required and which vendor command proves it; the readback Script is post-check only and F3 defaults remain a separate row.
expected_evidence: Current/target identical version and signed image/hash
Complete flash telemetry and reboot IDs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Primary fields consistently request a same-version reflash; the readback Script is incomplete rather than contradictory, and duplicate F3 text is isolated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The purpose is identifiable; vendor support, image/tool, approval and recovery are finite prerequisites. Execution stops if same-version support cannot be established.

review_improvement: Requires proof of an actual supported rewrite and configuration preservation instead of accepting an unchanged version string.
independent_technical_reasoning: A same-version reflash has the full brick risk of a firmware write but no version transition as proof. Therefore flash telemetry, exact image identity, vendor support and recovery are essential, and the finite gates make REQUIRES more accurate than DeepSeek NO.
